title: Three ways to switch an output
body_md:
The source names three switching modes:

- switched on continuously until the command is taken back,
- pulsed for one second,
- switched on for a freely selectable time.

How the outputs are controlled by text message is described in a separate section of the source.
source_region: Section 1.4, list and red note box
prev_context: Before this stand the load limits of the outputs.
